_doc: PvP maps built from TLOU2 single-player sections (re/maps/technical.md, re/maps/candidates.md).
Build: T2R_SP_MAPS=hardware,motel (or 'all' = every map with build: true) -> build_dll.py adds the maps
(dc_data_patches.patch_sp_maps). The daemon must get the SAME T2R_SP_MAPS to put them in the pool.
key: map id; level: task subnode under to1-levels (= daemon MAPS level name); pak: our spawner pak
level-sets-test.bin whose level list is replaced (entry table / exports stay untouched);
levels: what the set loads (art only: no *-script, NPC, encounter or cinematic levels);
props: cover props placed in our pak (filled by tools/maps/sp_maps.py props); seed_levels: script
levels whose spawners (NoR player starts, wave spawners, loot) seed placeholder spawns (sp_maps.py
extract/seed) - they are only READ offline, never loaded in the match.
index: fixed position in daemon MAPS / ext MF_MAPS (8 = first after Hospital).

Each built map gets its own new level set tsk-to1-<key>-1 (sp_maps_build.py); boundary blockers come from sp_bounds.py --write (props with auto: true, re-made on every run; hand-placed props are kept).

prefabs: [{preset, pos, yaw | quat}] vehicle presets (tools/maps/vehicle_presets.py, re/maps/vehicle-prefabs.md): sp_maps.py pak writes each as an actor spawner AND its SP vault / cover records into the pak FEATURE_DB_2; the actors load via prop_actors().
